releases.notes:
## 📓 Accessory slots: One of the changes from the previous release broke accessories. Most of the issue were fixed, but we are sure some fallen through the cracks. If you find any issue, please submit an issue on github or make it known on discord.

## 🐛 BugFixes: - Fixed lang key, now Ultimate Fist has a name and a description again - Phoenix shovel now work correctly in the overworld - Data required for the mimic hurt particles no longer attemps to access a client side only class, thus no longer crashed the server - Accessories now tick again - Accessories no longer play the equip sound when closing the inventory. - Accessories no take damage again. - Trinkets, like Compass, now render again. - Map now again updates while worn in the trinket slot. - Repulsive Shield now activates again. ## 🔽 Dependencies: - Halplibe >= [HalpLibe 6.2.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/halplibe/version/6.2.0+8.0.1) - Catalyst = [3.1.4](https://modrinth.com/mod/catalyst/version/3.1.4) - UselessNumerical >= [1.1.1-8.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/bta-uselessnumerical/version/1.1.1-8.0) More precisely the following version are required. Note that the catalyst-all version contains the correct version of both of these: - Catalyst-Core >= [3.0.5](https://github.com/MartinSVK12/catalyst/releases) - Catalyst-Effects >= [3.0.1](https://github.com/MartinSVK12/catalyst/releases) **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bta-team-port/better-with-aether/compare/1.1.0-release...1.1.1+8.0.1

releases.notes:
## ❤️ Special Thanks Thanks to @SajmonOriginal for doing an exceptional work porting Aether in a playable state to 8.0.1, @Simple205 for you work on the fire minion and @LukeisStuff for his hard work and dedication when it comes to models and textures. Additional I must thank **camoweed_** for setting up the instance and giving me the opportunity to test stuff on multiplayer. ## ⚠️ Important As always make a backup of your world before upgrading. Report any issues you find either in discord or open up an issue in this repository. ## 📑 Changes - No longer depends on dragonfly as dragonfly was merged into BTA. - More Deathcauses including while ridding and through poison. - Aether's color correction now scaled with a slide, can be found in Aether Options. - Most block support block models. - Controller support for container. - Terrain under a floating island is now decorated. - New Blocks: - Scorched Aether Log, when a aether tree is burned up. Crafts into Skyroot Planks Black. - Holystone Pressure Plate, Cobble Holystone Pressure Plate and Holystone Button. - Holystone Statue. - Blocks changes: - Added more item to the aether blacklist: - Sulfer Fire, Cold Fire, Magma, Brimthaw, Magma Bolder, Sulfur Bolder, Ember - New Items: - Wolf armor: Zanite, Gravitite, Obsidian, Phoenix, Neptune variants. - Jebber, a magical wand - Ultimate Gloves, good for punching and digging - Phoenix tools, process all harvested ressources. - Item changes: - Phoenix bow can now also shoot Fire Arrow - Iron pendant now give protection, this is weaker and different from chainmail - Boss Key are now indstructible and persistent - Quiver can now be equipped by right click.

- Mob changes: - Added Simple205 Fire Minion model. - Mob can now also made invisible (currently not uses ^^). - Valkyries can now be also left handed. - Evil bunny makes a return to ruin your servers again( jk its just a bunny variant). - Zephyr is now better at aiming the windball at player. - Zephyr windball no longer curved with player view angle. - Ridable mob now sits when saddled. - Slider has now proper pathfinding. - Maze boss room no longer contain trapped blocks, instead Slider spawn sentries on a timer. - Custom death animation for Slider - Custom hurt animation for Slider, sentry and mimic - Sunspirit no longer spawns fire on the ground. - The amount of fireminion summoned by the Sunspirit now depends on the player count

## 🐛 Bug Fixes: - Fixed sounds on working on the server - Chainmail gloves and pendants count to the chained up achievement. - Made /kill more consistent. - Gloves no longer take damage when hitting dead or invincible targets. - Parachute no longer teleport you down. - Ice pendant is now consistent. - Lifeshard now works with extra health. - Fixed discord rich presence. - Zephyr is now again capable of hitting the player. - While fixing aether for 8.0 we fixed many more bugs. - Player are now properly immune to many sources of fire damage, rather than taking a tick of damage. ## Teasers - Future Content:

releases.notes: ## ☀️ PreRelease2 Aether 8.0.1 As always, back up your world! We fixed many of the bugs the community raised over the last week. As some of you know, we originally planned to make an expansion mod for BWA (Aether's Edge). While the project is dead, we intend to reuse some of the items and expand on the concepts in upcoming releases. Here are some screenshots: ## 📑 Changes: - Chain Pendant now has increased defensive stats. - Iron Pendant now provides defensive stats. - Added a freezer recipe for Obsidian Wolf Armor. ## 🪲 BugFix: - Accessories no longer occupy the same space when boots aren't equipped. - They no longer snap while we look for a fix. - Dimension init was reverted to how it was before the changes last week. - As mentioned above, make a backup. - Lifeshard now correctly counts how many times the player has used it. - Aether no longer overrides CreativeInventory. - Windball now hits players on the server. - Fixed camera drift withhin vehicles. - Rideables can no longer be duplicated on the server. - Pigs now accelerate again. - Blowgun now shows the next dart in the GUI. - On the server, repair recipes no longer require the client to also enable them client-side to connect to the server. - Improved Ice Pendant; it should now more consistently freeze the ground. - At high velocity, you might still fail to freeze the surface. - Growth of saplings no longer depends on the seasons. - Moa jump amount is now saved, so it cannot be exploited through relogs. ## 🔽 : Dependencies: - Halplibe >= [HalpLibe 6.2.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/halplibe/version/6.2.0+8.0.1) - Catalyst = [3.0.2](https://modrinth.com/mod/catalyst/version/3.0.3) - UselessNumerical >= [1.1.1-8.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/bta-uselessnumerical/version/1.1.1-8.0) More precisely the following version are required. Note that the catalyst-all version contains the correct version of both of these: - Catalyst-Core >= [3.0.1]() - Catalyst-Effects >= [3.0.0]() ## What's Changed * Recipe fixes, sapling growth rate, aercloud material, save jump amount for rideables, optimize world gen a bit by @LukeisStuff in https://github.com/bta-team-port/better-with-aether/pull/875 * Portal Fix, DeathLoop Fix, RecipeNamespace Fix by @Redart15 in https://github.com/bta-team-port/better-with-aether/pull/877 * Blowgun and Rideable fixes by @LukeisStuff in https://github.com/bta-team-port/better-with-aether/pull/878 * Fixed CreativeInventory, LifeShard partial fix, Dim adjustments and AccessoryHud by @Redart15 in https://github.com/bta-team-port/better-with-aether/pull/880 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bta-team-port/better-with-aether/compare/1.1.0-pre1...1.1.2-pre2

## ☀️ PreRelease Aether 8.0.1 
We’ve been rather busy IRL, so we haven’t had much time to address everything that’s been reported yet. However, two game breaking bugs have been fixed in the meantime.

# 🪲  BugFix:
- Portal can now again teleport the player to the hostile paradise
- DeathCause could loop on itself crashes in SinglePlayer and Multiplayer alike.

## 🔽 :  Dependencies:
- Halplibe >= [HalpLibe 6.2.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/halplibe/version/6.2.0+8.0.1)
- Catalyst = [3.0.2](https://modrinth.com/mod/catalyst/version/3.0.3)
- UselessNumerical >= [1.1.1-8.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/bta-uselessnumerical/version/1.1.1-8.0)

More precisely the following version are required. Note that the catalyst-all version contains the correct version of both of these:
- Catalyst-Core >= [3.0.1](<https://github.com/MartinSVK12/catalyst/releases>)
- Catalyst-Effects >= [3.0.0](<https://github.com/MartinSVK12/catalyst/releases>)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bta-team-port/better-with-aether/compare/1.0.3-release...1.1.1-pre1

releases.notes:
## ☀️ PreRelease Aether 8.0.1 The Aether is mostly playable. As we learned from the Aether beta, QA is important. So, to make sure the game is not just playable but smooth for everyone, we’re going to do a prerelease. This gives us some extra time to find and fix the remaining issues before the full release. As always we are providing a ready to go instance. Thanks to @SajmonOriginal for doing an exceptional work porting Aether in a playable state to 8.0.1, @Simple205 for you work on the fire minion and @LukeisStuff for his hard work and dedication when it comes to models and textures. ## ⚠️ Important As always, make a backup of your world before upgrading.Report any issues you find either in Discord or by opening an issue in this repository. Before I let you have a go at the 8.0.1 release, a couple of disclaimers: there are a few things that are definitely broken: - Slider AI is even more broken than before. As such, he has been put into a deep sleep and won’t wake up to fight you. - Entrance tunnels for the Maze either fail to generate or break the boss room and have therefore been disabled. - It’s possible to find inaccessible boss fights. - Dungeon collisions: all 3 dungeons tend to generate in close proximity to one another. We don’t know what is causing it. - Chunk generation is even slower than before. It’s unclear what is causing it. - Some changes aren’t playing nicely: - Creative Inventory Menu won’t work with other mods due to how Aether sorts the items. - An aggressive mixin into getting the model renderer under control can result in broken models. - We have fixed all affected BTA vanilla models (currently, this is only the Slime). - The BTWaila overlay and Boss Bar occupy the same space. We are working on getting these issues fixed.
